description: List fixed public-page keyspace ranges without scanning content, or pass a range to read current canonical paths and modification times. Private, unlisted, hidden, and API-only objects are excluded before page limits. Website crawlers can read /sitemap.xml instead. A range exceeding 50,000 pages fails explicitly and needs finer index partitions.

from.description: Inclusive ID boundary from the sitemap index. Omit both boundaries to list fixed keyspace ranges.

to.description: Exclusive ID boundary from the sitemap index.

name: sitemap
title: Sitemap
